kept.spine: This town neither backs the Elected Reeve nor stands in its way, and a hard decision here would have to be paid for out of an empty purse.
The market is full, and the Elected Reeve is well thought of on the strength of that market.
The Elected Reeve holds Hochhausen, the village expects no different, and what is agreed here is agreed on that footing.
Nothing here governs on its own, and the Elected Reeve is an arrangement between the guilds and the church that moves at the pace of the least willing.

kept.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
kept.spine: The village reeve governs here under the name Elected Reeve, and the name is the exact size of the place, whatever people passing through hear in it.
There are people here who would govern in place of the Elected Reeve if it could be done, and it cannot, and nobody on either side pretends otherwise.

kept.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public opinion neither helps nor hurts
kept.spine: What the village thinks of the Elected Reeve neither adds to it nor takes from it, and the Elected Reeve stands on its own strength.
